label: Pen
depicts: Diagonal pen body with one pointed tip at lower left and one rounded cap above
use_when: Use when the interface wants a full pen body angled across the icon instead of a nib frame.
avoid_when: Do not use for the pencil variants when the tip shape and cap details should match a pencil body.

label: Pencil
depicts: Diagonal pencil body with one pointed tip at lower left and one eraser cap above
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simple pencil body angled diagonally across the icon.
avoid_when: Do not use for the underline or squiggle pencil variants when a second mark should appear below.

label: Pencil
depicts: Diagonal pencil body above one short underline bar at the lower right
use_when: Use when the interface wants a pencil paired with a short underline bar beneath it.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain pencil when no extra line should appear under the body.

label: Pencil
depicts: Diagonal pencil body above one wavy line mark at the lower right
use_when: Use when the interface wants a pencil paired with a short wavy line under the tip.
avoid_when: Do not use for the underline pencil when the lower mark should stay straight and flat.

label: Photo Album
depicts: Stacked photo frame with one back sheet behind one mountain picture panel
use_when: Use when the interface wants a photo panel with a second sheet stacked behind it.
avoid_when: Do not use for the bound album cover when a top binding strip should cap the frame.
